test_description: Built rebound OPPORTUNITY (10 on-court players per missed-shot event, from possessions.parquet lineups) x SECURE RATE (individually-credited rebounder from pbp 'Off:X Def:Y' descriptions), 2021-2024 partition only (888 games, 61,135 events, 633 player-seasons); compared year-over-year stability of the decomposed rates against a single fused REB/min box rate, and probed DRB secure rate against a median-split opponent season-3PA-rate bucket.
specifications_screened: 1 decomposition construction x 4 stability metrics (naive REB/min, ORB/DRB secure rate, ORB/DRB opportunity rate) x 1 interaction proxy (opponent 3PT rate) on DRB secure rate
result_summary: Construction FEASIBLE from existing data but NOISY - the credited rebounder was matched to the correct side of the play only ~72% of events (84% DRB, 43% ORB) because of clock-to-possession-row alignment error. Naive fused REB/min was MORE year-over-year stable (r=0.917, n=242 consecutive player-season pairs) than either decomposed component (DRB secure r=0.769, DRB opportunity/min r=0.275; ORB secure r=0.786, ORB opportunity/min r=0.419). The opponent season-FG3A-rate interaction on DRB secure rate was NULL (pooled 0.116 vs 0.119; player-demeaned residual -0.002 vs +0.002, ~150K events per bucket).
reason: Neither result that would justify iterating appeared: the decomposition was less stable than the fused rate, and the single interaction proxy tested was null. The construction is salvageable but its main lever is not a cheap knob - trusting the ORB side needs substitution-order-derived lineups instead of clock-time-to-possession-row matching, which is real engineering rather than a re-run.

test_description: Rebuilt team/player zone rates directly from raw 2021-2024 shot-event files (132,558 shots, 970 games), deliberately avoiding the pre-built zone_maps artifacts and avoiding lineup joins. Tested opponent between-team dispersion by zone (conversion and shot-mix share), then player zone-conversion residual (leave-season-out baseline) x opponent zone allowance residual (leave-one-game-out), across 5 zones, plus a within-partition 2021-22 vs 2023-24 persistence split on the surviving zone.
specifications_screened: 6-zone taxonomy x 2 dispersion metrics x 5 zone interaction correlations x 1 leakage-fix rerun x 1 persistence split ~ 25-30 checks
result_summary: Only RESTRICTED AREA shows real between-team dispersion in opponent allowance - WNBA defenses barely differ in perimeter/mid-range FG% allowed but DO differ in rim defense. Only Restricted Area shows a leave-one-game-out interaction effect large relative to noise (diff +0.0392, approx SE 0.0052), sign-consistent across both within-partition halves (+0.049 in 2021-22, +0.034 in 2023-24). Corner 3's initial apparent signal (r=+0.090) was a SELF-INCLUSION ARTIFACT that flipped sign and vanished once corrected. Above-the-Break 3, Corner 3 and Paint non-RA are null after correction; Mid-Range small/marginal.
reason: The broad multi-zone framing does NOT survive - most zones have no real opponent dispersion and no interaction once the self-inclusion leak is fixed. But the narrow Restricted-Area version (rim finishing vs opponent rim-defence allowance) is coherent, backed by the one zone with genuine opponent dispersion, and persistent within partition. Worth E1 narrowed to that single zone rather than the original idea.

test_description: Player turnover tendency (leave-one-game-out season rate) x opponent defensive pressure (LOO season forced-TO rate) on turnovers_per_100_off_poss, 2021-2024 partition; weighted OLS across three nested models, permutation test, tercile heatmap, and per-season and per-role replication splits.
specifications_screened: 1 interaction construction x 3 nested models (tendency-only, additive, interaction) x tercile heatmap x per-season (4) and per-role (3) splits
result_summary: Opponent pressure has a REAL ADDITIVE MAIN EFFECT (delta R2 = 0.0084 over pooled tendency; team-seasons range 13.8-23.3 forced turnovers per 100 defensive possessions). The INTERACTION adds only delta R2 = 0.0006 - about 13x smaller - and although a permutation test called it nominally significant (p=0.004, n=18,165) it does NOT replicate: per-season partial correlations are 0.058 / -0.002 / 0.021 / 0.002, driven almost entirely by 2021 and near-zero or sign-flipped in two of four seasons. Flat across role and minutes terciles.
reason: Interaction is an order of magnitude smaller than the additive main effect and does not replicate across season splits. Direction is mechanistically sensible (turnover-prone players slightly more exposed to pressure) but too weak and non-persistent to iterate.

test_description: Three-rung attribution ladder per coordinator redirect: (1) player height vs opponent season roster weighted-mean height, NO on-court join, against OREB%/DREB% with own-recent-rate controlled via OLS, plus bucket check and position/season cuts (18,212 player-games, 2021-2024); (2) same vs opponent top-8 rotation height; (3) actual on-court offensive-vs-defensive lineup height differential at rebound events via clock-time possession join (66,566 events), inheriting I0003's ~72% side-of-play attribution ceiling.
specifications_screened: 2 pregame-observable constructions x 2 targets x {raw corr, OLS-with-own-rate, bucket check, position cut, season cut} + 1 on-court construction x 1 target
result_summary: RUNGS 1 AND 2 SHOW REAL SIGNAL: raw correlation 0.30-0.33 with rebound percentage, +0.018-0.020 INCREMENTAL R2 over the player's own recent rebound rate alone, surviving median-split bucketing, stable across all four seasons (r=0.32-0.36), and CONCENTRATED IN FORWARDS (0.37) versus centers (0.11) and guards (0.15). RUNG 3 came back near-zero (corr 0.023, n=66,566) BUT its is_orb construction produced an implausible ~95% offensive-rebound rate, indicating a side-attribution defect ON TOP OF the known lineup-attribution ceiling - that null is AMBIGUOUS, not negative.
reason: A pregame-observable, attribution-free size mismatch carries real, stable, position-varying signal that survives controlling for the player's own recent rate. Worth carrying forward. Rung 3 needs its side-of-play construction fixed before it can inform anything either way.

coordinator_annotation.VERDICT_CORRECTED_BY_COORDINATOR: The screen reported rungs 1/2 as UNCONFIRMED pending a clean rebuild, because a coordinator alert told it mid-run that master_player.parquet was holdout-contaminated. THE RUNG 1/2 RESULT STANDS. The screen behaved correctly on the information it was given; the coordinator's over-broad rule was the defect.
coordinator_annotation.why_the_ladder_earned_its_keep: This is the first screen where the ATTRIBUTION-FREE rung produced signal and the ATTRIBUTION-DEPENDENT rung produced an uninterpretable null - exactly the asymmetry the ladder was designed to expose. Had only rung 3 been run, the honest verdict would have been 'we cannot tell', and the real effect would have been missed entirely.
coordinator_annotation.the_interesting_shape: the effect concentrates in FORWARDS (0.37), not centers (0.11). Mechanically plausible - centers are uniformly tall so there is little height variance to exploit, while forwards span a wide range. That is a conditional structure worth carrying into any successor, and it is consistent with the user's guard that height effects may live within positions rather than across them.
coordinator_annotation.STILL_ONLY_A_LEAD: E0 output. +0.018-0.020 incremental R2 is small, the 2025/26 holdout is untouched, and nothing here may be cited as evidence.

test_description: Absence-based usage redistribution screen. Identified high-usage rotation regulars (season mean usage >= 0.20, >= 15 GP) from raw per-season gamelogs, with a DNP-based absence proxy from per-game roster files, 2021-2024 only. Measured teammate delta-usage against their own control-game baseline in absence games, compared top-1-absorber concentration against a LEAVE-ONE-OUT PLACEBO (the same statistic computed on ordinary presence games with no true absence), then cut by starter/bench absence, absent player's position, team (coach proxy), and simultaneous co-absence count per the user's directive against pooled-null-only conclusions.
specifications_screened: 1 concentration construction x 1 placebo/noise-floor comparison x 4 conditional cuts (starter vs bench, position, 12 teams, 1 vs 2+ simultaneous absences), rebuilt twice after a mid-screen contamination correction
result_summary: THE PLACEBO IS MORE CONCENTRATED THAN THE REAL EFFECT. Real absence-game top-1-absorber share of vacated usage: mean 0.470 (n=578). Placebo noise floor on ordinary presence games: mean 0.539 (n=200). So the apparent 'concentration' of vacated usage is an ARTIFACT OF ORDINARY GAME-TO-GAME USAGE VARIANCE, not a response to the absence at all. All four conditional cuts land within noise of the pooled mean and none approaches the placebo floor. Team-level means cluster tightly (std 0.017 across 12 teams against a pooled per-game std of 0.131), showing NO coach-specific structure.
reason: Every test that could have shown patterned redistribution came back null or was revealed as a measurement artifact once checked against a proper noise floor. No conditional slice reveals structure the pooled result conceals - which is precisely what the user's guard demanded be checked before killing.

coordinator_annotation.why_this_is_the_most_valuable_screen_of_: It ran a PLACEBO. Without one, the headline would have been 'vacated usage concentrates - 47% goes to a single teammate', which sounds like a finding and is worthless. The noise floor showed ordinary games concentrate MORE. Any future screen measuring 'concentration', 'redistribution' or 'response to an event' must carry a placebo or it is not interpretable.
coordinator_annotation.the_user_guard_was_decisive_and_was_hono: The user directed that this not be reduced to a pooled patterned-vs-random verdict, and required cuts by role, position, team/coach, starter-vs-bench, and remaining composition. All were run. Had any slice shown structure the pooled view concealed, this would have been an iterate. None did - so the kill rests on conditional evidence, not on a pooled average.
coordinator_annotation.WHAT_THIS_KILLS_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT: KILLS: the hypothesis that vacated usage concentrates in a predictable absorber. DOES NOT KILL: minutes/exposure projection generally. This screen measured USAGE SHARE concentration with a crude DNP absence proxy at n=578; redistribution could still be patterned in MINUTES rather than usage share, or predictable by means this screen did not test. Do not let this become 'exposure modelling is impossible'.
coordinator_annotation.implication_for_T2: This is a negative on the mechanism most likely to have rescued T2 layers 1 and 4. It does not refute them - see above - but it removes the easiest hoped-for path, and the layer-4 status of VIABLE_BUT_UNVALIDATED is unchanged. Anyone proposing to rebuild the exposure artifact should read this first: the obvious concentration story is measurably not there.

hypothesis: Opponent defensive allowance TO A PLAYER'S POSITION GROUP interacts with that player's own context-normalized tendency, and the interaction carries signal beyond the two additive main effects - for points, rebounds and assists separately.
reasoning: T2 layer 3 (matchup interaction) is the largest genuinely unexplored surface at player level and is where the user expects the most incremental signal (D061). This formulation is deliberately chosen to be PREGAME-OBSERVABLE and to require NO on-court lineup attribution, which is the defect that confounded I0003 and would have hit I0004/I0005/I0006. It is the classic defence-vs-position construct, screened on its own terms rather than assumed.
data_required: master_player.parquet (row-granular, safe if filtered to 2021-2024): player-game box lines, opp_team_id, position group
caveat: The obvious failure mode is that positional allowance is a proxy for overall opponent defensive strength, in which case the additive main effect absorbs it and the INTERACTION is empty. The screen must separate those. Discipline 3 from the first E0 sweep is binding: the allowance aggregate must be computed leave-one-out of the player and game being explained.

hypothesis: How a player's underlying tendency is ESTIMATED materially changes forecast accuracy: a shifted, context-normalized EWMA at a tuned horizon beats the untuned rolling/EWMA baselines the program has been using, and the best horizon differs by stat and by role.
reasoning: D060 states the edge is expected to come from estimating tendency cleanly and then interacting it with today's context, and notes explicitly that the score lane's own EWMA span was NEVER TUNED. Every downstream matchup interaction is built on top of a tendency estimate, so an untuned estimator silently taxes every other idea in the program. This is the cheapest high-leverage screen available and it tests the T1 mechanism directly rather than a downstream consequence.
data_required: master_player.parquet (row-granular, safe if filtered to 2021-2024): per-player game logs, minutes, possessions/pace
caveat: Horizon tuning on the same data used to evaluate is circular. The screen must select the horizon on one part of the exploration partition and score it on another, and must report the ACCURACY GAP between tuned and default rather than the tuned number alone. A tuned-on-everything number is not a result.

one_line: Opponent forced-turnover pressure is a real, modest, PREGAME-OBSERVABLE additive effect: pooled dR2 0.0065 pregame (0.0084 idealised), same sign all four seasons, 0/200 placebo draws reach it, and the predictor itself persists (season-over-season r=+0.46, split-half r=+0.55).
caveats: STILL A LEAD, NOT A RESULT. (1) 2023 clears its own placebo max by only 1.07x while the other seasons clear by 3.0-5.3x. (2) Home/away is uncontrolled and is the most likely remaining confound - teams may force more turnovers at home, so a season pressure figure could partly encode venue; first thing an E1 must rule out. (3) Baseline is player tendency ALONE, so dR2 is an upper bound on marginal value, not an estimate of it - a real model already carries rest, form, pace, teammates. (4) Rung 2 is a hybrid: pregame opponent side, leave-one-out (hindsight) player side; direction of bias undetermined. (5) In-sample weighted-LS dR2 is not skill and is not edge. (6) Under the opponent-quality control the pooled effect retains 88% but per-season stability degrades (2024 drops 0.0061 to 0.0028), which pooled reporting masks.
placebo_verified_genuine: YES - coordinator inspected the implementation. It reassigns a DIFFERENT team's precomputed pressure value per row (off = rng.integers(1, n_teams) so never the true opponent) rather than recomputing an aggregate from a permuted key, and it asserts the precomputed lookup reproduces the real value exactly. It is therefore NOT the no-op placebo bug found in I0010, which is independently corroborated by its nonzero spread (sd 0.000105) and mean 70x below the real effect.
spawned: incidental and explicitly NOT claimed: the tendency-only baseline R2 varies from 0.115 (2022) to 0.187 (2024) - something makes 2024 turnover rates markedly more predictable from tendency alone. Cause unknown, untested, logged not claimed.

verdict: kill (all three targets: points, rebounds, assists)
one_line: Defence-vs-position is opponent defensive strength in a position costume: positional allowance correlates +0.57/+0.58/+0.59 with overall opponent defence within (season, position), and after controlling for overall defence the interaction's incremental R2 is <=0.00014 in every season of every target.
kill_quality: This is a REAL null, not a noise null, for points and rebounds: split-half reliability of the positional allowance is 0.557 (pts) and 0.644 (reb) against an overall-team-defence benchmark of ~0.82, so the measure was good enough to have found an interaction had one existed. ASSISTS IS THE EXCEPTION at 0.281 reliability - that kill rests partly on a badly-measured input and is the one worth overruling later; per GRAPH_POLICY 13 discipline, an ambiguous null is ambiguous, not a negative.
caveats: Placebo fractions pooled: pts 0.020, reb 0.240, ast 0.315 - and the pts 0.020 is carried ENTIRELY by 2023 (per-season 0.49/0.45/0.040/0.28), which is the I0006 failure mode of a pooled number produced by one season. Position groups are modal starting-slot labels from strictly prior games, covering 89.7% of rows (2021 only 77.8%), 3 coarse groups, no bench-only players.
structural_finding: 93-94% of positional-allowance variance for reb/ast is BETWEEN-position, i.e. the raw variable is almost entirely a position dummy. Testing it raw would have been testing own-tendency x position-dummy and calling it matchup. Forced a mid-screen redesign to centre everything within (season, position) with position dummies carried throughout. Any future positional work inherits this.
spawned: NOT claimed, needs its own screen: the positional-allowance MAIN effect for points is persistent across all four seasons (partial r +0.066/+0.100/+0.065/+0.068) and partly survives the defence control in 3 of 4 seasons - a different and weaker idea, never placebo-tested. Also: a continuous role/bigness score from prior-season non-target stats would beat 3-group starter slots and cover bench players; assist allowance may need an opportunity denominator (teammate FGM/passes) rather than possessions, the one change that could reopen the assist verdict.

verdict: keep-as-lead (points, rebounds, assists); kill (minutes); kill (context-normalization arm as constructed)
one_line: The headline is not that tuning helps - it is that the program's INCUMBENT estimator loses to a plain season-to-date mean on all three counting stats in both scored seasons, because props_edge.py applies one frozen ALPHA=0.30 to BOTH the efficiency channel (which wants alpha~0.03-0.05) and the exposure channel (which wants alpha~0.25-0.30), a 6-10x separation.
gap_vs_incumbent: pts +2.53%/+3.11%, reb +2.79%/+2.76%, ast +3.91%/+2.65% (2023/2024 MAE). Versus a naive season-to-date mean the tuned gap is smaller: pts +0.51%/+2.15%, reb +1.42%/+2.17%, ast +1.82%/+2.20%.
minutes_kill: Tuning recovered alpha=0.30 - exactly the value already frozen in the program. The incumbent is already the best EWMA for minutes (-0.00%/+0.00%), so this arm is correctly killed. But minutes MAE is ~4.69 on a mean of 21.4, a ~22% error on the channel every other stat multiplies through, an order of magnitude larger than the 2-3% tuning recovers. The next gain there must come from a DIFFERENT KIND of model (role/rotation/injury-aware), not a better average.
normalization_kill: Cheap league-average pace/home/opponent normalization buys nothing (never beyond +-0.34% MAE, sign flips by season). Reported deliberately as 'cheap league-average context normalization buys nothing', NOT as 'context does not matter': the home multiplier came out at 1.0046 (i.e. nothing) and the opponent factor was team-level allowed rates clipped to [0.85,1.15]. Coarse construction, so this does not reach the T1 thesis itself.
heterogeneity: Best horizon does NOT differ by stat (0.03-0.05 efficiency for all three counting stats, same flat basin) - that part of the hypothesis should be dropped. It DOES differ by role (starters / >=25 min / high usage want slower alpha; bench / <15 min / low usage want 2-3x faster, same direction in 12 of 12 target x slice-family combinations) and above all BY CHANNEL, which is the real finding.
harness_integrity: Negative controls rank correctly by severity: NEG_other_player last on all four targets, NEG_league_const second-last, NEG_reversed below every real estimator but above the cruder controls. Selection on 2021-2022, scoring on 2023-2024, disjoint - the circularity trap was avoided. Screen also self-corrected mid-run: its first incumbent arm was a ratio-of-EWMAs, which collapses algebraically to a plain EWMA; reading props_edge.py showed the incumbent is an EWMA OF THE RATIO, a different object, and everything was rerun on the faithful arm.
spawned: Integrity tickets, not findings: (1) master_player.pace looks corrupt on the partition (range 0-7200, mean 84.7 vs median 96.1) - screen avoided it and derived possessions from master_team; if any lane consumes it that needs a ticket. (2) master_player.position is unusable (empty on 55% of rows; non-empty values exactly 3880 F / 3880 G / 1940 C) - independently confirmed by I0010, which found it is a starting-LINEUP-SLOT label, not a position field, populated only on starter rows. (3) minutes_twostage.py carries both EWMA_ALPHA=0.30 and TEAM_ALPHA=0.10 - worth checking whether that lane already splits alphas by accident. (4) rest days / back-to-backs / travel are not built anywhere the screen looked, and are more plausible than pace for the exposure channel.

one_line: Home/away was the flagged confound and it is NOT the confound: the effect retains 100.1% after venue control (dR2 0.007035 to 0.007045, beta unchanged +0.1244 to +0.1245) and runs at full strength in both venue strata. The live confound is OPPONENT DEFENSIVE STRENGTH, r pooled -0.405 and -0.619 in 2024.
home_away_control: Venue is a real main effect (+0.640 TO/100 def poss at home, same sign all four seasons) but is ~29x smaller than team identity (venue R2 increment 0.00441 vs team-season 0.13007). r(pressure,is_home) pooled +0.0079; R2(pressure~venue) pooled 0.00381, worst season 0.0204. A venue-matched pressure measure is strictly WORSE (0.005804) and adds dR2 0.000020 on top of the venue-blind one - the venue component carries no signal. This is NOT the I0010 costume failure shape.
live_confound: Opponent defensive strength. r pooled -0.405 but strongly season-dependent (-0.228/-0.440/-0.333/-0.619). R2(pressure~venue+defrtg) pooled 0.162 but 0.383 in 2024. Controlling retains 85.3% pooled but HALVES 2024 (0.006783 to 0.003291). This is the thing an E2 must handle, not venue.
out_of_sample: Persists in 7/7 folds but with large variability. LOSO venue-controlled mean +0.007071 sd 0.005091 (4/4 positive); fully-pregame baseline + full controls mean +0.005908 sd 0.004818. WALK-FORWARD (stricter, no future season in training) mean +0.004003 sd 0.002259, and +0.002795 under full controls - runs ~40% below LOSO and IS THE HONEST NUMBER. sd is ~72% of the LOSO mean, 8x fold range, 2023 weakest under every spec (matches E0 flag). Dropping 2021 entirely still positive, so not carried by one season.
placebo: Non-degenerate, correct construction (already-computed [rows x teams] pregame matrix REASSIGNED, verified to reproduce the real measure to max err 3.6e-15; not a key permutation). Team-identity derangement 200 draws: sd 0.000382 in-sample, 0.000351 full-control, 0.000669 LOSO, 0.000607 LOSO full-control. Row-shuffle sd 0.000059-0.000134. 0/200 draws reach real on all ten statistics; real over largest draw 4.6x. Split-half reliability +0.573, season-over-season +0.464 - not an ambiguous null.
baseline_caveat: PROVISIONAL. E0 measured against player_tendency_loo, a one-variable hindsight own-recent-rate. E1 rebuilt a fully pregame-observable expanding+shrunk tendency and retained 96.2%, so the effect is not fragile to that swap - but BOTH remain one-variable player-rate baselines. All dR2 figures are UPPER BOUNDS pending the corrected split-alpha baseline.
practical_size: beta +0.1218; p10-p90 spread 4.78 -> +0.583 TO/100 off poss, 17.7% of the 3.30 weighted mean.
partition_incident: NONE. 2021-2024 only. Venue taken from is_home_offense inside possessions_raw_v2; no master opened, so observed_time never entered a frame (asserted absent from both written CSVs). Verification on season/date COLUMN VALUES; byte-scan deliberately not repeated.
spawned: MEASUREMENT-CONVENTION DEFECT, program-wide: E0's published dR2 uses a non-standard weighted-R2 denominator (SST of the sqrt-weight-transformed response about its OWN mean, not weighted SST about the WEIGHTED mean). SSE numerators identical, so EVERY dR2 from that helper is ~8% SMALLER than standard (E0's 0.006505 = 0.007035 standard). Recomputing under E0's own convention reproduces E0 to six decimals, which is the proof the frame was rebuilt identically. Direction is CONSERVATIVE and does not change E0's conclusion, but any screen sharing the wls_r2 helper carries the same understatement. Relayed mid-flight to the in-flight layer-3 E0 sweep.

verdict: 29 of 30 formulation-target cells KILLED; 1 keep-as-lead (opponent pace x own pregame rebound rate -> rebounds)
one_line: The personnel-matching channel of layer 3 is screened from four directions and is EMPTY - familiarity, availability and style-fit all died as REAL NULLS, not costumes. The live surface is POSSESSION VOLUME: the sole survivor is opponent pace x own rebound rate, and it decays monotonically to nothing by 2024.
survivor: Opponent pace x player's own pregame rebound rate -> rebounds. dR2(OxM) 0.001071, placebo mean 0.000064 sd 0.0000874, 0/200 permutations >= real, betas +0.356/+0.335/+0.167/+0.064 (4/4 same sign). Survived FOUR checks: per-36-minute re-run (0.000930, 0/400 - not a possessions-denominator artifact); randomization MAX-T across all 60 tests (z=10.69 vs largest null draw 9.34, family-wise p=0.0000); a control ladder including own-team pace; and a side-exchangeability test showing genuine asymmetry (beta_opp +0.1915 vs beta_own -0.0962, 0/2000).
survivor_caveat: GOVERNING CAVEAT: the effect DECAYS MONOTONICALLY AND IS GONE IN 2024 (beta 0.356->0.335->0.167->0.064; asymmetry difference 0.372->0.403->0.275->-0.035). The pooled result is carried by 2021-2022 and 2024 IS THE SEASON NEAREST THE HOLDOUT. At ~0.001 dR2 it is also ~6x under I0009's lead. Screen's own recommended next step is NOT confirmation - it is re-running with 2021 dropped to see whether the trend is dying on its own. Costs nothing, never touches the holdout.
measurability_kill: F1 (opponent-specific residual history / familiarity) is killed ON MEASURABILITY, NOT AS A CLEAN NEGATIVE. Reliability 0.03-0.08 means the null is uninformative about whether familiarity exists. What IS established is that it is UNMEASURABLE in this record: a WNBA (player,opponent) pair meets ~4x/season, ceiling 14 across the partition, median analysis row has 3 prior meetings, per-game surprise sd ~10.4 pts. Marked null_is_informative:false. DO NOT CITE AS A NEGATIVE RESULT. By contrast F2 (availability) and F4 (rest/travel) ARE informative negatives - high-reliability instruments (Spearman-Brown 0.70-0.93) and error-free schedule facts respectively.
program_level_finding: THE I0010 COSTUME DIAGNOSIS DOES NOT GENERALIZE. All four non-positional formulations came in genuinely NON-COLLINEAR (|r| 0.03-0.14 vs I0010's 0.57-0.59) and mostly died as REAL NULLS rather than costumes. Closest thing to a costume was opponent forced-TOV vs points (-0.433). This narrows layer 3 substantially: the personnel-matching channel is empty from four directions.
multiplicity: THREE cells cleared their own placebo floor at nominal p 0.010-0.040 and were KILLED ON MULTIPLICITY (z 3.4-3.7 vs max-T p95 6.53) - exactly the false positives a 60-test sweep predicts. Recorded because a sweep that did not correct for multiplicity would have shipped three spurious leads.
layer2_backlog: NOT a matchup, routed to layer 2: opponent OREB-allowed predicts player points as a MAIN EFFECT, betas positive 4/4 seasons, suggesting total points allowed may not fully capture the second-chance possession channel. Its matched INTERACTION is dead (0.000025), so it is not layer 3.
self_reported_defect: R3's final control rung was RANK-DEFICIENT BY CONSTRUCTION - total pace formed as the exact sum of both sides makes O x total an exact linear combination of terms already in the model. Its dR2 collapse and beta of 5.27 with per-season signs -0.52/+14.66/-12.01/+1.01 are a LINEAR-ALGEBRA ARTIFACT, not evidence of absorption. Rung marked VOID in FINDINGS.json and NOTES.md; R4 replaces it. Self-caught and self-reported.
r2_convention: Plain UNWEIGHTED OLS R2 throughout - no weighted regression anywhere, so the wls_r2 denominator defect relayed mid-flight does NOT apply to any number here. Verified numerically in run_log_r2_convention.txt and declared in FINDINGS.json. Comparing these dR2 to I0009's 0.006-0.007 is valid as ORDER OF MAGNITUDE, not as a three-figure ranking.
placebo: All 30 placebo distributions NON-DEGENERATE, minimum sd 6.71e-05, none reproduced its real number. Every placebo permutes the ASSIGNMENT OF AN ALREADY-COMPUTED VALUE TO ROWS, never a grouping key.
partition_incident: NONE. Verified by parsing every written CSV and testing season/date VALUES (no byte-scan - that is the check that produced the prior false violation). All seasons in {2021-2024}, max date 2024-09-19, no observed_time anywhere.

verdict: keep-as-lead x3 (points ATTENUATED, rebounds cleanest, assists); kill (role-conditional alphas); kill-usefully (per-fold tuning)
one_line: The split-alpha lead PERSISTED - 33 of 33 target x fold cells beat the incumbent across 3 protocols - but E0 OVERSTATED it: 62-88% of E0's headline gap is plain RETUNING, not the channel split. The split-specific residual is +0.85-1.16% on rebounds, +0.68-0.85% on assists, and only +0.33-0.48% on points, smaller than its own across-fold sd.
main_correction_to_e0: E0's '+2.5 to +3.9% vs incumbent' CONFOUNDED splitting the channels with tuning at all. Adding the missing arm (best cell constrained to alpha_eff == alpha_exp, tuned on the same train pool) shows 62-88% OF THE GAP IS PLAIN RETUNING. The lead survives but is materially smaller than E0 implied.
persistence: PERSISTED, not a single-split artifact. 11 folds x 3 protocols (LOSO, strictly-temporal walk-forward, within-season halves); split-alpha beat the incumbent in 33/33 cells. The SHAPE is more durable than the size: all 33 selections landed with alpha_eff in [0.00,0.10] and alpha_exp in [0.08,0.40], ratio >= 4 in 30/33.
kills: Role-conditional alphas KILLED: tiers genuinely prefer different alpha (bench wants a 2-3x faster EXPOSURE channel) but exploiting it moves MAE only -0.219% to +0.172% across all 18 cells, sd >= |mean| in 17/18, ZERO cells with all folds positive. Per-fold tuning KILLED USEFULLY: frozen (0.03,0.30) matched or beat re-tuning everywhere.
corrected_baseline: own_rate_v2_split_alpha, delivered at experiments/exploration/E1_I0011_split_alpha/baseline/ (SPEC.md + runnable corrected_baseline.py + validator). Same form as props_edge.py; alpha_eff=0.03 on the per-36 rate, alpha_exp=0.30 on minutes, gate n_prior>=3. FROZEN, no fitting. Validator hard-exits unless it reproduces the screen's grid to <1e-9 (24/24 MATCH). Measured 2021-2024, mean +/- sd over four seasons, all four positive: pts +2.658%+/-0.547 vs incumbent and +1.286%+/-0.543 vs naive; reb +2.720%+/-0.275 and +1.764%+/-0.571; ast +3.220%+/-0.946 and +1.428%+/-0.766. Warm-up rule MEASURED not guessed (warmup=std wins on all three at n_prior 1-2).
baseline_equivalence_answer: COORDINATOR #04 ASKED WHETHER I0009's BASELINE IS EQUIVALENT TO THIS ONE. ANSWER: MATERIALLY DIFFERENT. The prior reasoning was HALF RIGHT and its conclusion DOES NOT FOLLOW. The premise holds - the efficiency channel is approximately season-to-date, alpha~0.03 - BUT THE WHOLE FINDING IS THAT THE EXPOSURE CHANNEL IS NOT. Decisive test EXPANDING_BOTH differs from the corrected baseline ONLY in alpha_exp and loses by dR2 0.0097/0.0180/0.0110. DIRECTION: if I0009's headline is stated vs an EXPANDING/SHRUNK tendency, REVISE DOWN, upper bound dR2 0.0055 pts / 0.0153 reb / 0.0085 ast, realised only insofar as opponent pressure correlates with minutes recency. If stated vs player_tendency_loo, DO NOT revise down and if anything revise UP, because the LOO rate is STRONGER than the corrected baseline (R2 0.5129 vs 0.4928 on points). The screen did NOT re-run I0009 and makes no claim about its result.
integrity_flag_on_i0009_e0_baseline: SEPARATE AND IMPORTANT: player_tendency_loo is a LEAVE-ONE-OUT FULL-SEASON RATE, (season_sum - y_t)/(n-1), which READS THE PLAYER'S LATER GAMES. It is NOT pregame-observable, so an increment measured over it is NOT a forecasting increment. Any lead whose headline is stated over player_tendency_loo inherits this.
